title: Joomla site written in another language: no __CONTENT_SLOT__ mask written as a heading, no words written into an address slot (JA Boxing 1.0.4 Vietnamese footer headings, Plans link-btn)
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-written-headings.test.mjs (siteLanguage and sourceLanguage plans naming headings whose source is the mask)
S2: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-guard.test.mjs with the address-slot tests (link-btn typed text, url, image, alias, email, phone)
expect: S1: the set call carries only the real heading (module-200.title), never a key whose source or answer is __CONTENT_SLOT__
S2: guardWritten and guardChanges hold every word written into an address slot and keep addresses, e-mails and numbers
evidence: accept-boxing-1722-vi.tracy.site and accept-boxing-104-vi.tracy.site, curl 25/10/2026: 196 __CONTENT_SLOT__ on 61 pages, 4 href="/Xem chi tiết" on /index.php/plans
fence: the plugin's mask is never words; an address slot takes only an address

cmd: --test-name-pattern=never writes the mask over a heading|an address slot never takes words|an e-mail or phone field takes
tests: a one-edition site written in Vietnamese never writes the mask over a heading
a two-edition site written in Vietnamese never writes the mask over a heading
an address slot never takes words, whatever its type says (JA Boxing link-btn, 25/10/2026)
an e-mail or phone field takes an e-mail or a number as a visitor reads it, never a translated word
